Posiva given go-ahead to operate Finnish used fuel repository
articles.원문 요약: Finnish radioactive waste management company Posiva has been granted a licence to operate the encapsulation and final disposal facility for used nuclear fuel located in Olkiluoto. It is the world's first repository for used fuel to be granted such a licence.

articles.제목: FID sees Etango enter full-scale construction
articles.원문 요약: A positive final investment decision from the Bannerman Energy-CNNC Overseas joint venture means the Etango uranium project in Namibia can transition into full-scale construction activities, with commissioning and production targeted for 2028.

articles.제목: Rosatom eyes 2027 for Uzbek large reactor construction
articles.원문 요약: Rosatom plans to launch construction of the large-scale nuclear units at the planned power plant in Uzbekistan in 2027, CEO Alexey Likhachev has said during a visit to the construction site.

articles.제목: Slovenia's deep borehole disposal options studied
articles.원문 요약: The US firm Deep Isolation has conducted a cost assessment for Slovenia's radioactive waste agency which has concluded it would be more economic for used fuel from the TRIGA II research reactor and from the Krško Nuclear Power Plant to be placed in the same disposal facility deep underground.
